class Problem:
    """
    Represents a problem in the ACM Problem-Solving Platform.

    Attributes:
        id (int): Unique identifier for the problem.
        title (str): The title of the problem.
        description (str): A detailed description of the problem.
        difficulty (str): The difficulty level of the problem (e.g., Easy, Medium, Hard).
        tags (list): A list of tags related to the problem.
    """

    def __init__(self, id: int, title: str, description: str, difficulty: str, tags: list = None):
        """
        Initializes a Problem instance.

        Args:
            id (int): Unique identifier for the problem.
            title (str): The title of the problem.
            description (str): A detailed description of the problem.
            difficulty (str): The difficulty level of the problem.
            tags (list, optional): A list of tags related to the problem. Defaults to None.
        """
        self.id = id
        self.title = title
        self.description = description
        self.difficulty = difficulty
        self.tags = tags or []

    def __repr__(self):
        """
        Returns a string representation of the Problem instance.
        """
        return f"<Problem {self.id} - {self.title}>"

from flask import Blueprint

# Aggregating all blueprints
def register_blueprints(app):
    from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_bp
    from app.controllers.user_controller import user_bp
    from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_bp

    app.register_blueprint(problem_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(user_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(solution_bp)

from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_bp
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_bp
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_bp

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Configuration can be set here if needed
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(problem_bp, url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_bp, url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_bp, url_prefix='/solutions')

    # Return the app instance
    return app

from app import create_app

app = create_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)

# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems.

## Features

- Problem Repository: A comprehensive collection of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays a ranking of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Tutorials: Provides hints and tutorials to help users understand problem-solving techniques.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
